verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a model platform that runs agents and offers cloud capacity, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Ollama providing a scheduler, cron-like triggers, or recurring workflows. The REST API, SDKs, `ollama launch`, and OpenClaw integrations cover one-off requests and agent launching, not recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
